translation: Ta, Seen, Meem
These are the Verses of the Clarifying Book

arabic: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٞ نَّفۡسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: Perhaps you will destroy yourself with grief, because they do not become believers

arabic: إِن نَّشَأۡ نُنَزِّلۡ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةٗ فَظَلَّتۡ أَعۡنَٰقُهُمۡ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ
translation: If We will, We can send down upon them a sign from heaven, at which their necks will stay bent in humility

arabic: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن ذِكۡرٖ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مُحۡدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضِينَ
translation: No fresh reminder comes to them from the Most Merciful, but they turn their backs at it

arabic: فَقَدۡ كَذَّبُواْ فَسَيَأۡتِيهِمۡ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُاْ مَا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
translation: They have denied the truth, but soon will come to them the news of what they ridiculed

arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَمۡ أَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجٖ كَرِيمٍ
translation: Have they not seen the earth, and how many beautiful pairs We produced therein

arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers
Most surely, your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful

arabic: وَإِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئۡتِ ٱلۡقَوۡمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
translation: Your Lord called to Moses, “Go to the tyrannical people
The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear?”

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
translation: He said, “My Lord, I fear they will reject me

arabic: وَيَضِيقُ صَدۡرِي وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرۡسِلۡ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ
translation: And I become stressed, and my tongue is not fluent, so send Aaron too

arabic: وَلَهُمۡ عَلَيَّ ذَنۢبٞ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقۡتُلُونِ
translation: And they have a charge against me, so I fear they will kill me.”

arabic: قَالَ كـَلَّاۖ فَٱذۡهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسۡتَمِعُونَ
translation: He said, “No. Go, both of you, with Our proofs. We will be with you, listening

arabic: فَأۡتِيَا فِرۡعَوۡنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: Go to Pharaoh, and say, ‘We are the Messengers of the Lord of the Worlds
Let the Children of Israel go with us.'“

arabic: قَالَ أَلَمۡ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدٗا وَلَبِثۡتَ فِينَا مِنۡ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
translation: He said, “Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you stayed among us for many of your years

arabic: وَفَعَلۡتَ فَعۡلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِي فَعَلۡتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
translation: And you committed that deed you committed, and you were ungrateful.”

arabic: قَالَ فَعَلۡتُهَآ إِذٗا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
translation: He said, “I did it then, when I was of those astray

arabic: فَفَرَرۡتُ مِنكُمۡ لَمَّا خِفۡتُكُمۡ فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكۡمٗا وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
translation: And I fled from you when I feared you; but my Lord gave me wisdom, and made me one of the messengers

arabic: وَتِلۡكَ نِعۡمَةٞ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنۡ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation: Is that the favor you taunt me with, although you have enslaved the Children of Israel?”
Pharaoh said, “And what is the Lord of the Worlds?”

arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
translation: He said, “The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, if you are aware.”
He said to those around him, “Do you not hear?”
He said, “Your Lord and the Lord of your ancestors of old.”

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أُرۡسِلَ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمَجۡنُونٞ
translation: He said, “This messenger of yours, who is sent to you, is crazy.”

arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
translation: He said, “Lord of the East and the West, and everything between them, if you understand.”

arabic: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذۡتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيۡرِي لَأَجۡعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَسۡجُونِينَ
translation: He said, “If you accept any god other than me, I will make you a prisoner.”
He said, “What if I bring you something convincing?”

arabic: قَالَ فَأۡتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
translation: He said, “Bring it, if you are being truthful.”

arabic: فَأَلۡقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعۡبَانٞ مُّبِينٞ
translation: So he cast his staff; and it was a serpent, plain to see

arabic: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيۡضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
translation: And he pulled his hand; and it was white, for all to see

arabic: قَالَ لِلۡمَلَإِ حَوۡلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٞ
translation: He said to the dignitaries around him, “This is a skilled magician

arabic: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخۡرِجَكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِكُم بِسِحۡرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأۡمُرُونَ
translation: He intends to drive you out of your land with his magic, so what do you recommend?”

arabic: قَالُوٓاْ أَرۡجِهۡ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبۡعَثۡ فِي ٱلۡمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
translation: They said, “Delay him and his brother, and send recruiters to the cities
To bring you every experienced magician.”
So the magicians were gathered for the appointment on a specified day
And it was said to the people, “Are you all gathered

arabic: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
translation: That we may follow the magicians, if they are the winners.”

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُواْ لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجۡرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحۡنُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
translation: When the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, “Is there a reward for us, if we are the winners?”

arabic: قَالَ نَعَمۡ وَإِنَّكُمۡ إِذٗا لَّمِنَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبِينَ
translation: He said, “Yes, and you will be among those favored.”

arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلۡقُواْ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلۡقُونَ
translation: Moses said to them, “Present what you intend to present.”

arabic: فَأَلۡقَوۡاْ حِبَالَهُمۡ وَعِصِيَّهُمۡ وَقَالُواْ بِعِزَّةِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ
translation: So they threw their ropes and their sticks, and said, “By the majesty of Pharaoh, we will be the winners.”

arabic: فَأَلۡقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلۡقَفُ مَا يَأۡفِكُونَ
translation: Then Moses threw his staff, and behold, it began swallowing their trickery
And the magicians fell down prostrating
They said, “We have believed in the Lord of the Worlds
The Lord of Moses and Aaron.”

arabic: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ قَبۡلَ أَنۡ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمۡۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحۡرَ فَلَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَأَرۡجُلَكُم مِّنۡ خِلَٰفٖ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
translation: He said, “Did you believe in Him before I have given you permission? He must be your chief, who taught you magic. You will soon know. I will cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you all.”

arabic: قَالُواْ لَا ضَيۡرَۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
translation: They said, “No problem. To our Lord we will return

arabic: إِنَّا نَطۡمَعُ أَن يَغۡفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: We are eager for our Lord to forgive us our sins, since we are the first of the believers.”

arabic: ۞ وَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِيٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation: And We inspired Moses: “Travel with My servants by night. You will be followed.”
Pharaoh sent heralds to the cities
“These are a small gang
And they are enraging us
But we are a vigilant multitude.”
So We drove them out of gardens and springs
And treasures and noble dwellings
So it was. And We made the Children of Israel inherit them
And they pursued them at sunrise

arabic: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلۡجَمۡعَانِ قَالَ أَصۡحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدۡرَكُونَ
translation: When the two groups sighted each other, the followers of Moses said, “We are being overtaken.”

arabic: قَالَ كـَلَّآۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
translation: He said, “No; my Lord is with me, He will guide me.”

arabic: فَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضۡرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرۡقٖ كَٱلطَّوۡدِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
translation: We inspired Moses: “Strike the sea with your staff.” Whereupon it parted, and each part was like a huge hill
And there We brought the others near
And We saved Moses and those with him, all together
Then We drowned the others

arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: In that there is a sign, but most of them are not believers
Surely, your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful
And relate to them the story of Abraham

arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
translation: When he said to his father and his people, “What do you worship?”

arabic: قَالُواْ نَعۡبُدُ أَصۡنَامٗا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ
translation: They said, “We worship idols, and we remain devoted to them.”
He said, “Do they hear you when you pray
Or do they benefit you, or harm you?”

arabic: قَالُواْ بَلۡ وَجَدۡنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفۡعَلُونَ
translation: They said, “But we found our ancestors doing so.”
He said, “Have you considered what you worship
You and your ancient ancestors

arabic: فَإِنَّهُمۡ عَدُوّٞ لِّيٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: They are enemies to me, but not so the Lord of the Worlds
He who created me, and guides me
He who feeds me, and waters me
And when I get sick, He heals me
He who makes me die, and then revives me

arabic: وَٱلَّذِيٓ أَطۡمَعُ أَن يَغۡفِرَ لِي خَطِيٓـَٔتِي يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ
translation: He who, I hope, will forgive my sins on the Day of the Reckoning.”

arabic: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي حُكۡمٗا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِي بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
translation: “My Lord! Grant me wisdom, and include me with the righteous

arabic: وَٱجۡعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدۡقٖ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرِينَ
translation: And give me a reputation of truth among the others
And make me of the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss

arabic: وَٱغۡفِرۡ لِأَبِيٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
translation: And forgive my father—he was one of the misguided
And do not disgrace me on the Day they are resurrected

arabic: يَوۡمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٞ وَلَا بَنُونَ
translation: The Day when neither wealth nor children will help

arabic: إِلَّا مَنۡ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلۡبٖ سَلِيمٖ
translation: Except for him who comes to God with a sound heart.”
And Paradise will be brought near for the righteous
And the Blaze will be displayed to the deviators

arabic: وَقِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَيۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡبُدُونَ
translation: And it will be said to them, “Where are those you used to worship?”

arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلۡ يَنصُرُونَكُمۡ أَوۡ يَنتَصِرُونَ
translation: Besides God? Can they help you, or help themselves?”
Then they will be toppled into it, together with the seducers
And the soldiers of Satan, all of them
They will say, as they feud in it

arabic: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٍ
translation: “By God, We were in evident error
For equating you with the Lord of the Worlds
No one misled us except the sinners
Now we have no intercessors
And no sincere friend

arabic: فَلَوۡ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةٗ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: If only we could have another chance, we would be among the faithful.”

arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers
Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful
The people of Noah disbelieved the messengers

arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation: Their brother Noah said to them, “Do you not fear
I am to you a faithful messenger
So fear God, and obey me

arabic: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: I ask of you no payment for this. My payment is only from the Lord of the Worlds
So fear God, and obey me.”
They said, “Shall we believe in you, when it is the lowliest who follow you?”

arabic: قَالَ وَمَا عِلۡمِي بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: He said, “What do I know about what they do

arabic: إِنۡ حِسَابُهُمۡ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّيۖ لَوۡ تَشۡعُرُونَ
translation: Their account rests only with my Lord, if you have sense
And I am not about to drive away the believers
I am only a clear warner.”

arabic: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمَرۡجُومِينَ
translation: They said, “If you do not refrain, O Noah, you will be stoned.”
He said, “My Lord, my people have denied me

arabic: فَٱفۡتَحۡ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ فَتۡحٗا وَنَجِّنِي وَمَن مَّعِيَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: So judge between me and them decisively, and deliver me and the believers who are with me

arabic: فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
translation: So We delivered him and those with him in the laden Ark
Then We drowned the rest

arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: In that is a sign, but most of them are not believers
Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful
Aad disbelieved the messengers

arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation: When their brother Hud said to them, “Do you not fear
I am to you a faithful messenger
So fear God, and obey me

arabic: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: I ask of you no payment for this. My payment is only from the Lord of the Worlds
Do you build a monument on every height for vanity's sake
And you set up fortresses, hoping to live forever
And when you strike, you strike mercilessly
So fear God, and obey me
And reverence Him, who supplied you with everything you know
He supplied you with livestock and children
And gardens and springs

arabic: إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
translation: I fear for you the punishment of an awesome Day.”

arabic: قَالُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡنَآ أَوَعَظۡتَ أَمۡ لَمۡ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡوَٰعِظِينَ
translation: They said, “It is the same for us, whether you lecture us, or do not lecture
This is nothing but morals of the ancients
And we will not be punished.”

arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: So they denied him, and We destroyed them. Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers
Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful
Thamood disbelieved the messengers

arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ صَٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation: When their brother Saleh said to them, “Do you not fear
I am to you a faithful messenger
So fear God, and obey me

arabic: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: I ask of you no payment for it. My payment is only from the Lord of the Worlds
Will you be left secure in what is here
In gardens and springs
And fields, and palm-trees whose fruits are delicious
And you skillfully carve houses in the mountains
So fear God, and obey me
And do not obey the command of the extravagant

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا يُصۡلِحُونَ
translation: Who spread turmoil on earth, and do not reform.”
They said, “You are surely one of the bewitched

arabic: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا فَأۡتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
translation: You are nothing but a man like us. So bring us a sign, if you are truthful

arabic: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٞ لَّهَا شِرۡبٞ وَلَكُمۡ شِرۡبُ يَوۡمٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ
translation: He said, “This is a she-camel; she has her turn of drinking, and you have your turn of drinking—on a specified day

arabic: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٖ فَيَأۡخُذَكُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
translation: And do not touch her with harm, lest the punishment of a great day seizes you.”
But they slaughtered her, and became full of remorse

arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: So the punishment overtook them. Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers
Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful
The people of Lot disbelieved the messengers

arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ أَخُوهُمۡ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation: When their brother Lot said to them, “Do you not fear
I am to you a faithful messenger
So fear God, and obey me

arabic: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: I ask of you no payment for it. My payment is only from the Lord of the Worlds
Do you approach the males of the world

arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمۡ رَبُّكُم مِّنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ عَادُونَ
translation: And forsake the wives your Lord created for you? Indeed, you are intrusive people.”

arabic: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمُخۡرَجِينَ
translation: They said, “Unless you refrain, O Lot, you will be expelled.”
He said, “I certainly deplore your conduct.”
“My Lord, save me and my family from what they do.”
So We saved him and his family, altogether
Except for an old woman among those who tarried
Then We destroyed the others

arabic: وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِم مَّطَرٗاۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
translation: And We rained down on them a rain. Dreadful is the rain of those forewarned

arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers
Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful
The People of the Woods disbelieved the messengers

arabic: إِذۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ شُعَيۡبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
translation: When Shuaib said to them, “Do you not fear
I am to you a trustworthy messenger
So fear God, and obey me

arabic: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: I ask of you no payment for it. My payment is only from the Lord of the Worlds

arabic: ۞ أَوۡفُواْ ٱلۡكَيۡلَ وَلَا تَكُونُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡمُخۡسِرِينَ
translation: Give full measure, and do not cheat
And weigh with accurate scales

arabic: وَلَا تَبۡخَسُواْ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشۡيَآءَهُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِينَ
translation: And do not defraud people of their belongings, and do not work corruption in the land
And fear Him who created you and the masses of old.”
They said, “You are one of those bewitched

arabic: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡكَٰذِبِينَ
translation: And you are nothing but a man like us; and we think that you are a liar

arabic: فَأَسۡقِطۡ عَلَيۡنَا كِسَفٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
translation: So bring down on us pieces from the sky, if you are truthful.”
He said, “My Lord is Well Aware of what you do.”

arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ عَذَابُ يَوۡمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٍ
translation: But they denied him. So the punishment of the day of gloom gripped them. It was the punishment of a great day

arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers
Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful
It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds
The Honest Spirit came down with it
Upon your heart, that you may be one of the warners
In a clear Arabic tongue
And it is in the scriptures of the ancients

arabic: أَوَلَمۡ يَكُن لَّهُمۡ ءَايَةً أَن يَعۡلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُاْ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
translation: Is it not a sign for them that the scholars of the Children of Israel recognized it
Had We revealed it to one of the foreigners

arabic: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيۡهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: And he had recited it to them, they still would not have believed in it
Thus We make it pass through the hearts of the guilty

arabic: لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُاْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ ٱلۡأَلِيمَ
translation: They will not believe in it until they witness the painful punishment
It will come to them suddenly, while they are unaware
Then they will say, “Are we given any respite?”
Do they seek to hasten Our punishment
Have you considered: if We let them enjoy themselves for some years
Then there comes to them what they were promised

arabic: مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُمَتَّعُونَ
translation: Of what avail to them will be their past enjoyments

arabic: وَمَآ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
translation: Never did We destroy a town, but it had warners
As a reminder—We are never unjust
It was not the devils that revealed it
It is not in their interests, nor in their power
They are barred from hearing

arabic: فَلَا تَدۡعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُعَذَّبِينَ
translation: So do not pray to another god with God, else you will be of those tormented
And warn your close relatives

arabic: وَٱخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
translation: And lower your wing to those of the believers who follow you

arabic: فَإِنۡ عَصَوۡكَ فَقُلۡ إِنِّي بَرِيٓءٞ مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: And if they disobey you, say, “I am innocent of what you do.”
And put your trust in the Almighty, the Merciful
He Who sees you when you rise
And your devotions amidst the worshipers
He is indeed the Hearer, the Aware

arabic: هَلۡ أُنَبِّئُكُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
translation: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend
They descend upon every sinful liar
They give ear, and most of them are liars
And as for the poets—the deviators follow them

arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّهُمۡ فِي كُلِّ وَادٖ يَهِيمُونَ
translation: Do you not see how they ramble in every style
And how they say what they do not do

arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرٗا وَٱنتَصَرُواْ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا ظُلِمُواْۗ وَسَيَعۡلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَيَّ مُنقَلَبٖ يَنقَلِبُونَ
translation: Except for those who believe, and do good deeds, and remember God frequently, and defend themselves after they are wronged. As for those who do wrong, they will know by what overturning they will be overturned
